measurement_scope: Python process CPU time, RSS and actual config commits under Linux/Xvfb; excluded X server CPU; no Windows/game performance claims
sample_design: Three fresh processes; 300ms warmup; 5s visible idle; 5s withdrawn idle; 100 slider callbacks at 5ms; 300ms settle
reusable_harness: tools/performance/measure_gui.py preserves measured workload and adds portable CLI/provenance/validation
minimize_limitation: No window manager in Xvfb; withdrawn is hidden, not a Windows minimized measurement
